snippet.title: Grounded 2 - Announce Trailer | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Ride together, survive together

Grounded 2 is coming to Game Preview on July 29, 2025

Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.  

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
